notes.title: Postponing the release of the game to March 31
notes.notes:
Postponing the release of the game to March 31

Due to technical reasons (the problem is solved, but time is lost), the release of the game has been postponed for a week and will take place on [b]March 31st[/b].
Steam support refused to update the release date on the game page, so you have to use the news.

notes.title: Added Snail Mode
notes.notes:
A new Snail Mode has been added to the game, to help those who do not have very fast fingers to complete the game.
In the Snail Mode, the game slows down by 20%, you can turn this mode on / off at any time during the game.
This mode has already been added to the Demo version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33561562/d786b1e494eeff4dcf084ea29acd8658e0cc928b.png[/img]

notes.title: Game transformation
notes.notes:
After two years of silence, we are pleased to announce that the game has been unfrozen and will be released on February 17, 2023.
We had to abandon the free game + paid DLC distribution model in favor of a premium game with a demo version.
In 2020, when the game was announced, there were no demo festivals on steam yet. Now we can present the demo version of the game to a wide range of people.

A release trailer for the game will be released in December.
A demo version of the game will be released in January.

The game has changed over the past two years:
[list]
[*] Changed the graphic design of the game, switched from a 4-color palette to an 8-color one.
[*] Instead of opening the door with a key, now you need to collect all the coins on the map.
[*] There are different types of items that the player can use when passing the game (bombs, stairs).
[*] Enemies appeared (keepers of the labyrinth).
[/list]
